title: 8 ancient archaeological wonders that still exist today and reveal how people lived thousands of years ago
description: There is something surprisingly fascinating about standing in front of something that existed thousands of years ago. A ruined city, an ancient temple or even a 500-years old tree that has survived for centuries can make history feel less like something written in textbooks and more like something that is still around us.

title: Thousands of ancient trees discovered as project uncovers 'living heritage'
description: A growing network of ancient trees is being uncovered across Sussex thanks to the efforts of dedicated woodland preservation project.

title: Archaeology discoveries beneath Auckland Palace to feature in talk
description: Archaeologists will reveal Auckland Palace discoveries, including a medieval chapel and ornate ivory knife, at a Newcastle talk.

title: 63 History Memes That Might Make You Laugh At Our Twisted Recent And Ancient Past
description: If you loved history class, you’ll appreciate the sheer accuracy and humor in these memes. And if school lectures put you straight to sleep, they will finally make the past make sense — or at least give you a good laugh. We’ve collected the most accurate memes from a popular online page that routinely roasts history’s strangest moments. They will remind you that no matter how chaotic the modern world feels, our ancestors always had something even crazier up their sleeves.
